maturity.meaning: Research maturity only; not truth probability, evidence strength, transpersonal support, or readiness for canonical or public promotion.

scope.purpose: Map bounded claims, evidence, counter-interpretations and gaps across the six existing BQ002 domains.

sources.title: A meta-analysis of the relation between dream content and memory consolidation
sources.provenance: Existing BQ002 Batch 1 review-candidate source; metadata and bounded summary only.
limitations: The association does not establish that dream incorporation causes improved memory.
Tasks, dream collection and analytic methods varied across studies.
The findings do not explain the complete origin of thought or subjective awareness.

sources.title: The wandering brain: Meta-analysis of functional neuroimaging studies of mind-wandering and related spontaneous thought processes
sources.provenance: Indexed PubMed bibliographic record and peer-reviewed abstract-level review; metadata and bounded summary only.
limitations: The synthesis pooled 24 functional-neuroimaging studies with heterogeneous tasks and definitions.
Spatial convergence identifies correlates and does not establish a unique causal origin of thought.
A corrigendum exists and must remain linked as provenance rather than treated as a retraction.

sources.title: Mind-wandering as spontaneous thought: a dynamic framework
sources.provenance: Indexed PubMed bibliographic record and abstract reviewed on 2026-09-17.
limitations: The article proposes a theoretical framework rather than reporting one decisive experiment.
Large-scale network recruitment does not by itself identify the complete causal or phenomenal origin of a thought.
Mind-wandering, dreaming and creative thought should not be treated as one homogeneous phenomenon.

sources.title: The science of mind wandering: empirically navigating the stream of consciousness
sources.provenance: Indexed PubMed bibliographic record and publisher abstract reviewed on 2026-09-17.
limitations: Review-level synthesis depends on heterogeneous self-report and task-probe methods.
Retrospective awareness and report may miss or reshape the processes that preceded conscious access.
Functional costs and benefits vary with content, context and meta-awareness.

sources.title: Grounded cognition
sources.provenance: Indexed PubMed bibliographic record and abstract-level review; metadata and bounded summary only.
limitations: The review covers multiple grounded-cognition theories rather than one settled mechanism.
Evidence for sensorimotor and situated contributions does not show that every concept or thought is fully grounded in the same way.
Grounding mechanisms do not resolve why cognition is subjectively experienced.

sources.title: Predictive coding under the free-energy principle
sources.provenance: Peer-reviewed open repository record reviewed on 2026-09-17; metadata and bounded summary only.
limitations: The free-energy formulation is a broad theoretical framework and is not a direct observation of thought generation.
Model fit or explanatory scope does not establish that predictive coding is the unique cognitive architecture.
The framework does not by itself resolve phenomenal consciousness.

sources.title: The anticipating brain is not a scientist: the free-energy principle from an ecological-enactive perspective
sources.provenance: Indexed PubMed and PubMed Central record reviewed on 2026-09-17.
limitations: The paper presents a philosophical and theoretical critique rather than a direct experimental refutation.
Its ecological-enactive interpretation is itself one contested framework.
Disagreement over the meaning of inference constrains interpretation but does not eliminate empirical predictive-processing findings.

sources.title: Mind-Wandering as a Natural Kind: A Family-Resemblances View
sources.provenance: Publisher DOI record and indexed bibliographic search reviewed on 2026-09-17.
limitations: Conceptual analysis does not quantify the prevalence or neural basis of particular thought types.
A family-resemblances account may improve classification without resolving causal origin.
Operational heterogeneity remains an empirical problem even after terminology is refined.

claims.text: Across the studies synthesized by Hudachek and Wamsley, incorporation of learning-task content into dreams was positively associated with later memory performance.
limitations: Association does not establish causal direction or explain all dream content.
claims.unresolved_gap: Which mechanisms link pre-sleep learning, dream incorporation and later performance remains unresolved.

claims.text: A meta-analysis of functional-neuroimaging studies reported convergent recruitment of default-mode and executive-system regions during mind-wandering and related spontaneous-thought tasks.
limitations: Task and construct heterogeneity limits inference from spatial convergence to a single mechanism or origin.
claims.unresolved_gap: The temporal and causal contributions of interacting networks to specific thought content remain unresolved.

claims.text: Dynamic accounts treat mind-wandering as part of a broader family of spontaneous-thought phenomena whose content and movement reflect interactions among memory, affect, attention and cognitive constraints.
limitations: The category is heterogeneous and review-level frameworks are not unique causal explanations.
claims.unresolved_gap: Prospective measurements do not yet reconstruct a complete causal path from antecedent processes to a particular conscious thought.

claims.text: Grounded-cognition research supports treating perception, bodily state, action and situated context as contributors to cognitive content rather than assuming thought is isolated from them.
limitations: The contribution and necessity of grounding vary across theories, tasks and types of representation.
claims.unresolved_gap: No single grounded account currently explains every abstract, linguistic or spontaneous thought.

claims.text: Predictive-coding and free-energy frameworks offer testable ways to model how prior expectations, sensory signals and action may constrain cognition.
limitations: The framework has competing interpretations and does not uniquely specify the origin of every thought.
claims.unresolved_gap: Evidence must distinguish particular implementations and predictions rather than treating the framework's breadth as confirmation.

claims.text: Evidence about mechanisms, correlates and report constrains accounts of thought content but does not by itself resolve why thoughts are subjectively experienced.
limitations: This is a boundary on inference, not evidence for a transpersonal or non-biological source.
claims.unresolved_gap: The relationship between mechanistic explanation and phenomenal experience remains disputed.
